name: ai-studio-manager
description: Local-first AI workspace for SONIC-ARK music promotion

scripts.dev: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-meta-ai-cli.mjs
scripts.test: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node --test dist-electron/main/database/database.test.js dist-electron/main/database/release-plan-domain.test.js dist-electron/main/database/content-deletion.test.js dist-electron/main/release-plan-ai-generation.test.js dist-electron/main/database/workflow.integration.test.js dist-electron/main/database/workflow.negative.integration.test.js dist-electron/main/audio-analysis.test.js dist-electron/main/integration-resilience.test.js dist-electron/main/ollama-resilience.test.js dist-electron/main/local-services.resilience.test.js dist-electron/main/ai-harness.test.js dist-electron/main/execution-readiness.test.js dist-electron/main/harness-execution.test.js dist-electron/main/conversation-runtime.test.js dist-electron/main/harness-provider-router.test.js dist-electron/main/provider-trace-view-model.test.js dist-electron/main/distrokid-form.test.js dist-electron/main/meta-ai.test.js
